awardCategory.title: Award category
awardCategory.description: Which family of federal spending to pull. USAspending stores these as separate datasets — a single run returns one category, never a mix.

startDate.title: Period start
startDate.description: Include awards active on or after this date. ISO format, e.g. "2024-01-01".

endDate.title: Period end
endDate.description: Include awards active on or before this date. ISO format. Defaults to today.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Free-text search across award descriptions and recipients, e.g. ["cybersecurity", "cloud migration"].

maxItems.title: Maximum results
maxItems.description: Stop after this many awards. Maximum 50000.

agencies.title: Awarding agencies
agencies.description: Top-tier awarding agency names exactly as USAspending spells them, e.g. ["Department of Defense", "Department of Energy"].
agencies.sectionDescription: All optional. Filters combine with AND.

recipients.title: Recipient name contains
recipients.description: Match recipients by name, e.g. ["Lockheed", "Booz Allen"].

states.title: Place of performance states
states.description: Two-letter US state codes where the work is performed, e.g. ["VA", "TX"].

awardAmountMin.title: Minimum award amount (USD)
awardAmountMin.description: Only include awards worth at least this much.

awardAmountMax.title: Maximum award amount (USD)
awardAmountMax.description: Only include awards worth at most this much.
